0: Synechocystis ihabhakitiriya inoita fotosintitesi isina nyukiliyasi. Inogara nechiedza: inoburitsa oxyjeni pamaskamu ayo, isina mabhloroplastic. Mulabhoratori ndiyo muenzaniso wekuedza kwehydrojeni.
1: Anabaena variabilis ndiyo tambo yemaseli. Maseli amwe anova maheterokisiti anobata nitrojeni, vavakidzani vachigadzira shuga. Mudziva inopa nitrojeni yakabatwa.
2: Spirulina (Arthrospira) inhete yemaseli ine vesicles gasi. Inomira pedyo nedhrombhira yemvura, inoita fotosintitesi, uye inodyiwa. Mumtambo ndiyo skuru guru girini pafilemu yemvura.
3: Nostoc punctiforme ndiyo tambo yemabhandishi mukanzuru yemukaka. Inogara yokega kana mubatanidzwa nezvirimwa. Boka racho rinofanana nokuwanza kwemabhandichi girini.
4: Oscillatoria limnetica ndiyo tambo inoyandutsa. Inotambanuka kurudyi nekuchamhembe uye inogona kuita fotosintitesi isingaburitse oxyjeni. Inowanikwa mudhavhe nepamusoro pemvura.
5: Microcystis aeruginosa iboka remaseli remukaka, kazhinji rine toiksini (microcystin). Ndoyo inokonzera uwandu hwemadhrai pamusoro pemvura. Mumtambo ibhora girini reboka, chikafu chine njodzi.
6: Gloeocapsa maseli mabili muzvikwama zvane ruvara. Anogara pamatombo nedhaga uye anogona kumira UV. Mudziva makokisi madiki mabili mukanzuru.
7: Lyngbya majuscula tambo hombe yebhakitiriya inoita fotosintitesi. Inogona kuburitsa toiksini dzinokwesha. Inomisa uta hwemadhrai pedyo nemagombe anopisa.
8: Chlamydomonas reinhardtii seli girini ine maflajela maviri nedziso rechiedza. Inoshanda ichiona chiedza. Ndiyo muenzaniso wekare mujenetiki yemadhrai.
9: Chlorella vulgaris bhora girini risingafambi. Rinopatsanurwa zvakurumidza uye rine protein yakawanda. Chikafu chezvidiki, uye vanoishandisa muongororo yechikafu chokunze kwenyika.
10: Volvox globator bhora guru rogwenya rakagadzirwa nemaseli chiwumbazana. Maboka emadzimai anokura mukati mebhora obuda. Mumtambo ndiro boka guru girini.
11: Euglena gracilis inodya nzira mbiri: ine mabhloroplastic uye inogona kudya chikafu. Dziso tsvuku rinotevedza chiedza. Girini masikati; murusvongo chinoshandura kuenda kuchikafu.
12: Scenedesmus quadricauda kazhinji maseli mana mumutsara neminzwa pakugumira. Minzwa inoremedza kunywa. Haigoni kuhibha — inoyandutswa nemvura.
13: Haematococcus pluvialis seli girini inofamba; mukutambudzwa inova tsvuku (astaxanthin) uye inokura huswa hukobvu. Mazistse tsvuku anopfuurira zhara yemvura.
14: Dunaliella salina haina huswa hukobvu uye inogara mumvura ine munyu zvakanyanya. Inochengeta beta-carotene uye inoonekwa seyorengi. Ine maflajela maviri.
15: Micrasterias rotata ndiyo desmidi yakatambarara senyenyeri. Zvikamu zviviri zvakanangana zvine kudyara kwakadzika. Haifambi; inoita fotosintitesi mumvura yemabhogu ine asidi.
16: Navicula ndiyo diatomu yechikeche ine goko resilika. Inoyanduka pachishandiswa ichitevedza mbondera yeraphe. Goko rinoshuma mushure pokufa.
17: Pinnularia viridis ndiyo diatomu hombe yepennate. Goko resilika rine mufananidzo wakarongeka. Inoyanduka zvishoma pasi pe.
18: Cyclotella meneghiniana diatomu yakadenderedzwa. Inoyanduka sedhaisi; goko ndiro zvidayo zviviri. Plankton inozivikanwa.
19: Diatoma vulgare diatomu dzinobatana muzigizagi. Boka rarwo rinowedzera mhirizhonga mumvura.
20: Rhodospirillum rubrum spiral tsvuku. Fotosintitesi isingaburitse oxyjeni pamwe neorgani. Ruvara rutsvuku runobva mubhakterioklorofili.
21: Chromatium vinosum bhakitiriya tsvuku yesulfur. Inoshandura hydrogen sulfide uye inochengeta magraini esulfur. Inogara pamuganhu weoxyjeni nesulfur.
22: Porphyridium cruentum alga tsvuku yausel wega. Phycoerythrin inopa ruvara rutsvuku seropa. Kanzuru yemukaka, isina maflajela.
23: Prochlorococcus marinus ndiyo seli diki kupindura dzose dzinoita fotosintitesi, uye inowanda kupindura dzose pasi pano. Yakaonekwa muma1980. Ndoyo inodyetsa gungwa.
24: Chroococcidiopsis thermalis inogara munzvimbo dzakaoma: dhizerti, matombo, mhedesi (radiation). Ndiyo imwe yakanangana nehupenyu kunze kwenyika. Mudziva boka rechikokisi chakanyanyisa kuredza.
25: Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus bhakitiriya diki inodya dzimwe. Inopinda mukati meseli yemumwe bhakitiriya, ikawanda kusvika seli yabvaruka.
26: Vampirococcus inomira pachikafu chayo kunze, inomwa zviri mukati isiri kupinda. Ndiyo bhakitiriya inomwa ropa.
27: Daptobacter inopinda mubhakitiriya chikafu chayo ichidya mukati. Muvhigi mukati meseli akashoma.
28: Myxococcus xanthus bhakitiriya yebatanidzwa. Mutsumi inatenderedza chikafu uye inoburitsa maenzaimu. Pa chikafu chisina inova mutumbi wemichero.
29: Bacteriovorax stolpii hanzvadzi yemugungwa yaBdellovibrio. Inorwisa Gram-negative uye inogara muperiplasm yechikafu.
30: Halobacteriovorax muvhigi webhakitiriya unogona mumunyu. Njira imwecheteyo: kushura huswa nekukura mukati.
31: Peredibacter starrii mumwe muvhigi waBALO. Inokurumidza, yakaita sekoma, inorwisa mabhakitiriya hombe dzakaita semiti.
32: Monas guttula flajelate diki inodya organi. Inobata bhakitiriya pamusoro pedetritusi.
33: Oikomonas termo flajelate yakaita sedonhwe. Flajera imwe; inovhiga mufirimu yemabhakitiriya.
34: Anthophysa vegetans boka pachimuti cheiron-manganeze. Maseli anogara mutsumi anobata bhakitiriya.
35: Chilomonas paramecium cryptophyte isina ruvara. Maflajela maviri; inodya organi dzakanyunguduka nebhakitiriya diki, isina mabhloroplastic.
36: Cercomonas longicauda amoeboflajelate yakareba kumashure. Inofamba ichimepa bhakitiriya nepseudopodia.
37: Heteromita globosa flajelate yedhaga. Maflajela maviri akasiyana kureba; ndiyo inonyanya kudya bhakitiriya mudhaga.
38: Bodo saltans kinetoplastid. Inodzana panzvimbo imwe, yakabatana neflajera yekumashure, uye inobata bhakitiriya.
39: Procryptobia sorokini hanzvadzi yaBodo. Inofamba yokoga uye inorwisa chikafu neflajera yekumberi.
40: Trypanosoma brucei paramita yemaropa inokonzera indwara yokuzorora zvakanyanya. Ine memburani inofamba neflajera imwe. Mudziva ndiyo muenzaniso wevhigi wakatetepa.
41: Leishmania donovani paramita yemunhu inogara mukati meseli. Ine flajera muzvipukanana; isina flajera mukati memacrophage.
42: Monosiga brevicollis choanoflagellate, hama yezvipukanana. Kolari yemicrovilli inosunga bhakitiriya.
43: Salpingoeca rosetta choanoflagellate isingafambi iri mulorica. Inogona kuva rosette. Inosunga mvura inoyerera.
44: Codonosiga botrytis boka rechoanoflagellate pachimuti chimwecheteyo. Zvinosunga zvizhinji pachimuti chimwe.
45: Paramecium caudatum ndiyo shangu yakajairwa. Ine macilia mazhinji, mugwamwa wemukanwa, nemavhakuoli ekumanikidza. Inosunga bhakitiriya.
46: Paramecium bursaria shangu ine zuchlorella. Girini mukati: shuga kubva mualgae masikati, kusunga husiku.
47: Stentor coeruleus ndiyo trompeti yebluu kusvika kumilimita imwe. Inovhura yakaita sedhaisi, ichimanikidza mvura nemacilia. Inogona kushanda kana kugara.
48: Stentor polymorphus hanzvadzi yaStentor yebluu, kazhinji ine zuchlorella. Chiumbiko chacho chinoshandura kubva patorompeti kusvika pabhora.
49: Vorticella campanula ndiyo beere pachitanda chinokweshwa. Chitanda chinomonyorwa kuita spiral ipapo sahizha. Seli pachayo haifambi ichibuda.
50: Vorticella microstoma beere diki. Chitanda chokukweshwa chimwe chete, mugwamwa wemukanwa wutetepa. Kazhinji padetritusi.
51: Didinium nasutum barika muvhigi wemasangu. Inopfuridza toksisiti uye inomepa chikafu chose, kana chikuru kupindura iyo.
52: Spirostomum ambiguum sigara refu zvakanyanya. Inomanikidzwa kakawanda muzvikamu zvesekondi. Macilia anotevedza spiral.
53: Blepharisma americanum ciliati yepinki. Pigimindi blepharismin inotyora chiedza. Inosunga uye inogona kurwisa maseli madiki.
54: Euplotes patella inofamba pacirri semapedsu. Yakatambarara, kushanduka kwazvo zvikurumidza. Inokwesa bhakitiriya pamusoro pezvinhu.
55: Stylonychia pustulata hypotrich inorwisa pasi pe. Ciriri hombe, mukanwa wakajeka. Muvhigi wamacili madiki.
56: Oxytricha trifallax muenzaniso wejenomu: nyukiliyasi mbiri nekuchinjwa kweDNA kunorerama. Inofamba pacirri, inodya bhakitiriya maprotisti madiki.
57: Tetrahymena thermophila ciliati yelabhoratori. Membranelles mana emukanwa, kupatsanurwa zvikurumidza. Muenzaniso wetelomere nemacilia.
58: Coleps hirtus barika mupleyiti ekalesiyamu ane minzwa. Inodya zvakafa uye inovhiga: inokweva zvinorwadziwa.
59: Litonotus lamella muvhigi wakatambararira ane toksisiti mumhoro. Inomhatapira chikafu ichimwa zvarimo.
60: Dileptus anser mutsipa murefu une extrusomes dzine toiksini. Anorwisa nemutsipa, obva amedza. Muvhigi hombe wepakati.
61: Urocentrum turbo seli inodonha panzvimbo: bhandi remacili epakati inodonhedza seli pachayo. Inosunga bhakitiriya.
62: Zoothamnium arbuscula boka rakavadzwa mabele. Chitanda chimwe chakabatana chinokangaidza muti wose ipapo sahizha.
63: Opercularia coarctata peritrich isingafambi isina chitanda chokukweshwa. Chivharo chinovhara mukanwa. Inosunga uye haibudi.
64: Amoeba proteus ndiyo amiba yakajairwa. Pseudopodia inozvitenderedza chikafu. Isina chiumbiko chakadzikama, isina macilia.
65: Arcella vulgaris amiba ine goko rakasimba rakaumbwa sedhomo. Pseudopodia inobuda mugwanwa. Inofamba pazvirimwa.
66: Difflugia oblonga ine goko rakagadzirwa nemadhonha ejecha. Inogara mudhavhe.
67: Euglypha alveolata ine goko remakeyi esilika. Pseudopodia diki tete. Ndiyo muvhigi diki webhakitiriya.
68: Nebela collaris goko rebhodhoro rakagadzirwa nemakeyi akabirwa. Mvura yemasango nemabhogu.
69: Centropyxis aculeata goko redhaisi rine minzwa. Mugwanwa uri kudivi. Inofamba padetritusi.
70: Actinophrys sol heliozoan: axopodia diki anotenderedza nzvimbo dzose. Chikafu chinobatirira pamarwazi obva apinswa mukati.
71: Actinosphaerium eichhorni heliozoan hombe ine nyukiliyasi mazhinji. Marwazi emufananidzo, seli hombe zvikuru. Inodya macili nerotifere.
72: Raphidiophrys pallida heliozoan mumakeyi. Marwazi ane netsinga yesilika. Muvhigi weplankton anorindira.
73: Rotaria rotatoria rotifer inogona kupfuurira yoma. Korona inotumira chikafu mukanwa. Chisikwa chazvino chimwe chine maseli mazhinji.
74: Philodina roseola rotifer yeBdeloidi pinki. Inofamba pasi uye inogonawo kushavha. Hadzisi chete; asina varume.
75: Brachionus plicatilis rotifer yeLoricate iplanktoni. Chikafu chemacheche emafi mukurima kwemafi. Inosunga alge nebhakitiriya.
76: Keratella cochlearis rotifer ine minzwa yeLorica mirefu. Minzwa inovhimbisa vhigi. Plankton inowanzwa mudziva.
77: Asplanchna priodonta hembe isina Lorica, rotifer muvhigi. Inomepa dzimwe rotifere nemacili ose.
78: Chaetonotus maximus gastrotrich. Wakavharwa nemakeyi, inofamba pasi pe. Inodya bhakitiriya nedetritusi.
79: Lepidodermella squamata gastrotrich diki wakavharwa nemakeyi anodzerana. Kushandura kwazvo zviri mukati mekukurumidza.
80: Macrostomum lignano nyoka yakatetepa inoonekwa ne microscope. Ine masel-e-muviri echokwadi nemaziso. Muenzaniso wekugadziriswa zve. Inovhiga maprotisti madiki.
81: Stenostomum leucops nyoka yakatetepa ine macilia. Inopatsanurwa kuita chuma chemazoid. Muvhigi wedetritusi nezvisikwa zvidiki.
82: Microstomum lineare nyoka yakatetepa inodya hidra uye inoisira masel adzo ekurwadzisa muganda rayo. Chuma chemazoid.
83: Prostoma graecense nemertean yemvura chena. Mhoro murefu inopfurira chikafu. Muvhigi hombe pasi pe, akashoma.
84: Trichoplax adhaerens placozoan, wezvisikwa zvakapusa. Inofamba sebepa uye inaya chikafu kunze. Isina mukanwa.
85: Saccharomyces cerevisiae yasti yechingwa. Inodya shuga, inoburitsa CO2 nedoro. Mudziva inochenesa organi dzakanyungudika.
86: Candida albicans yasti inogona kukura semitande. Paramita yemunhu inorwisa paine hutano hushoma. Mumtambo fungusi yedetritusi.
87: Mucor mucedo fungusi wechingwa. Sporangia pachitanda, kukurumidza kukura pazvakafa. Haivhigi zvipenyu.
88: Rhizopus stolonifer fungusi tema wechingwa. Stolons nerhizoids dzinoparira pasi pe substrate. Inopatsanura starch.
89: Penicillium chrysogenum fungusi webhurashi, sosi yepenicillini. Mabhurashi emakonidiya. Inoputsa organi uye inodzikisa bhakitiriya iri pedyo.
90: Aspergillus niger aspergillusi tema. Mitwe yespure dzakadenderedzwa. Inogadzira citric acid yemafakitari. Saprotroph.
91: Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis chitiridi chefrogi. Zospore dzine flajera imwe. Mudziva muenzaniso wefungusi wemvura.
92: Chytriomyces aureus chitiridi chemvura che pollin ne alge. Sporangia zendarama; zospore dzinoshanda ku substrate.
93: Allomyces macrogynus fungusi wemvura une mycelium chaiwo. Unotsanangura diploid ne haploid. Zospore dzine flajera yekumashure.
94: Bacillus subtilis bhakitiriya yedhaga yakaita semuti. Spore dzinogona kupfuurira kufashira kwemvura. Inopatsanura protein; muenzaniso weGram-positive.
95: Pseudomonas putida bhakitiriya yekuchenesa. Inodya kunyange zvinobva mupetroleum. Ine flajera, inokurumidza kukura padetritusi.
96: Streptomyces coelicolor bhakitiriya yedhaga yakaita semiti. Inogadzira munhuvi wedhaga (geosmin) ne antibiotics mazhinji. Spure pahyphae.
97: Cellulomonas fimi inopatsanura cellulose. Bhakitiriya yeyelo yakaita semuti padetritusi zvirimwa. Isiri iyo, alge dzakafa dzaisagara nguva ndefu.
98: Thermus aquaticus thermophile kubva mumvura dzinopisa dzinobuda muvhu. Taq polymerase ndiyo bazisi rePCR. Mudziva coneja inenge yorara.
99: Deinococcus radiodurans ndiyo champiri yemajonjensi (radiation). Inogadzirasa jenomu yakaputsika maawa mashoma. Huswa hukobvu, tetradi dze seli.
1001: Sexual Eukaryote muenzaniso wekudzidzisa kudyarirana. Mutezo wemihariri maviri, kusangana kwegametes, asiri kupatsanura kwoga kwakapusa.
T4 Bacteriophage: T4 myovirus hombe yaE. coli. Mutsipa unomanikidza uchinodzeredza DNA. Muhafu ye awa seli inobvaruka, maphage mazhinji anobuda.
Lambda Phage: Lambda phage inogona kurarama nemamwe. Inogona kupinda muchromosome ikazorora (lysogeny) kana kucheka seli ipapo (lysis).
T7 Bacteriophage: T7 ine mutsipa mupfava uye inodzokorora zvikurumidza. Sisitimu inofarirwa mubayoloji we synthetic.
Phi-6 Phage: Phi-6 phage yeRNA ine envelope yelipid. Inorwisa Pseudomonas. Membrane inowanikwa zvikishoma kubva kumaphage.
MS2 Phage: MS2 phage yeRNA diki isina mutsipa. Inobatira pili ya E. coli yerume. Jenomu yayo yaiva imwe yejenomu dzeRNA dzokutanga kuwerengwa.
Neuro-Parasite: Neuro-paramita yekunyoredwa yemudziva. Inobatira paeukaryote uye inoputsa maitiro emuridzi kusvika muridzi ava mutakuri.
Sexual Eukaryote: Sexual Eukaryote muenzaniso wekudzidzisa kudyarirana. Mutezo wemihariri maviri, kusangana kwegametes, asiri kupatsanura kwoga kwakapusa.
